name: zutil_set_mission_zrdr_paths_and_mount_zbd
description: zUtil::SetMissionZrdrPathsAndMountZbd rebuilds mission ZRDR search paths, refreshes shared mission texture paths, and conditionally mounts the mission ZBD archive.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x42ecb0 show FreePathList(nullptr), ZRDR_AddSearchPaths(nullptr, "zbd"), zImage_InitMissionResources("..\\data\\common\\textures;..\\data\\common\\effects\\textures"), SetSearchPath("..\\data\\common\\zrdr;..\\data\\m%d\\zrdr;..\\data\\m%d\\zrdr\\aipath"), and a missionFlags gate that returns 0 or mounts "zbd\\m%d\\zrdr.zbd" with setCurrent=0.
Direct callees are dependency-ready and functional-equivalent; the indirect call is the imported sprintf formatter used for the two stack path buffers.
The native smoke verifies the loose-path-only return, creation of search/image path lists, and the archive-enabled branch returning the missing-archive mount result without adding a mounted archive.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x42ecb0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
